messages:
maya: quick heads-up: scheduling a small EU rollout tonight in the 02:00 CET change window. Its a kv-prefetch toggle + a short console blurb. Need final internal microcopy, L10N, and rollback triggers.

jon: are we doing canary?

maya: yes  5% -> 25% -> 100% if healthy. deploy-bot will orchestrate.

samir: oncall tonight, ack. what metrics should we watch?

jon: baseline checks: error rate, 95p latency, and request success. Proposed triggers: error rate >0.5% for 3m OR 95p latency +300ms for 5m OR any flagged quality regression from canary prompts.

maya: agreed. adding to runbook. Also note: Dedicated customers with pinning see no change unless they opt in.

lucy: L10N: please include DE/FR by EOD so we can post public blurb during the ramp.

maya: draft public microcopy (short): "Reduced initial response latency via improved prefix caching; no customer action required."

lucy: suggest swap "initial response latency" -> "first-response latency" per style guide.

maya: updated.

productops: please provide an internal one-liner we can paste to staff and ops channel.

maya: internal blurb: "Rolling out kv-prefetch toggle to prod-eu tonight (02:00 CET). Canary 5% -> 25% -> full. Oncall: @samir. Rollback: pin to redwood/inference:v2.14.2 if triggers hit."

jon: add the rollback kubectl snippet to the runbook so ops can act fast:
```
kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/inference:v2.14.2 -n prod-eu
```

samir: I'll watch SLO dashboard + small-signal monitor. I'll page and trigger rollback if criteria met.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to cluster: prod-eu at 2024-11-05T01:00:00Z; will execute canary per provided steps. :shipit:

maya: final ops runbook snippet to paste into the ops thread:
"Deploy plan (EU 02:00 CET)
- T+0: 5% canary
- T+10m: 25% if healthy
- T+30m: 100% if healthy
- Watch: error rate, 95p latency, query success, canary prompt quality
- Rollback: error rate >0.5% for 3m OR 95p latency +300ms for 5m OR manual regression flag -> pin to redwood/inference:v2.14.2
- Escalation: @samir -> follow paging playbook"

lucy: L10N confirmed DE/FR strings by 20:30 CET.

productops: adding a short internal release-note line: "No action required for Dedicated customers with pinned images; hosted users will see latency improvements."

maya: I'll post internal announce T-15 and paste staging canary logs link once available. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
